channel.title: Bryan County News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bryan County News (bryancountynews.com)

item.title: Disappointments
item.description: This week is the start of what is known as the “Big Dance”, which is the year end college basketball tournament. There is a committee that picks the teams based on their judgement of a team’s worthiness to get in. The winner from each conference tournament automatically gets in. The truth is that there are several teams that feel like they have been snubbed by being left out by the selection committee each year.

item.title: Follow the right
item.description: Every person from whatever background has the opportunity to do what is right. As we see in the news, each evening not everyone makes use of their opportunities.

item.title: An English Rose in Georgia: Flowers of spring
item.description: I am excited because, astronomically speaking, spring begins in the Northern Hemisphere tomorrow with the equinox on March 20. My spirits soar as soon as Daylight Saving Time begins along with these wonderful longer evenings.

item.title: Guest column: Travel recs: Disney’s EPCOT
item.description: Want to have a short, but entertaining trip around Europe and parts of Asia? Try Disney World’s EPCOT. Opened in 1982, EPCOT (Experimental Prototype Community of Tomorrow) can provide a tourist with a trip through Canada, England (United Kingdom), France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Morocco, Norway, and the ‘American Adventure’.

item.title: Editor's Corner: Leaping into spring
item.description: The green of Jesus is breaking the ground and the sweet smell of delicious Jesus is opening the house and the dance of Jesus music has hold of the air and the world is turning in the body of Jesus and the future is possible

item.title: Jeff Whitten: Do you want a medal?
item.description: Our president wants to give me a medal. I’m not kidding. It’s right there in my email spam folder.

item.title: Commissioners approve bonds in support of historic Pembroke theatre
item.description: Some $5.1 million in revenue bonds will be used for improvements to Pembroke’s historic Tos Theater after Bryan County Commissioners signed off on the Public Facility Authority’s issuance of the bonds earlier this month.

item.title: High school football schedules shaping up
item.description: March Madness is upon us but that doesn’t mean King Football is willing to take a backseat when it comes to sharing the limelight.

item.title: Threats to kill VA staff puts Hinesville man in federal prison
item.description: A Hinesville man who threatened to kill employees at the Department of Veterans Affairs has been sentenced to federal prison.
